book.title: Crit Hit & Run
invariants: No convenient amnesia as a continuity device.

chapters.title: The 100% Critical Failure
chapters.goal: Protagonist Arlo is isekai'd into 'Aethelgard Online' and discovers that his 'Luck' stat is so low it has integer-overflowed into a guaranteed 'Crit Hit' on every strike, provided he is running away.
chapters.stakes_shift: From confused victim to accidental glass-cannon exploiter.

bridge.from_prev: Arlo's mundane life ends in a freak vending machine accident.
bridge.to_next: Arlo realizes he needs a way to monetize his 'Run' mechanic without getting killed by the first mob that touches him.

chapters.title: Kiting the Tutorial Boss
chapters.goal: Arlo must defeat the Tutorial Guardian using only retreat-based attacks to secure enough starting gold for a 'Dash' skill book.
chapters.stakes_shift: From penniless newbie to a player with a unique, albeit cowardly, combat style.

bridge.to_next: The massive loot drop from the Guardian flags Arlo's account for 'unusual activity' in the local region.

chapters.title: The Gilded Scoundrel's Guild
chapters.goal: Arlo attempts to sell his high-tier tutorial loot in the city of Oakhaven but is intercepted by a guild of 'Min-Maxers' who suspect him of hacking.
chapters.stakes_shift: From solo survival to navigating player-driven politics and accusations.

bridge.from_prev: Arlo enters the main hub with a bag full of 'impossible' loot.
bridge.to_next: To prove he isn't a hacker, Arlo is forced into a 'Trial of the Coward' by the local guild leader.

chapters.title: The Trial of the Yellow Streak
chapters.goal: Arlo must clear a low-level dungeon while never facing an enemy head-on to satisfy the guild's curiosity and earn their protection.
chapters.stakes_shift: From being a social pariah to gaining a reluctant, confused ally in the guild's scout, Jax.

bridge.from_prev: The guild leader sets a 'no-frontal-damage' challenge.
bridge.to_next: The dungeon run uncovers a hidden 'System Glitch' zone that only Arlo can navigate.

chapters.title: Patch Notes and Panic
chapters.goal: A world-wide announcement declares an emergency maintenance patch to 'fix combat exploits'; Arlo must reach the Glitch Zone's heart to lock in his 'Coward' status as a permanent Title before the server resets.
chapters.stakes_shift: From a temporary exploit to a permanent, system-recognized class identity.

bridge.from_prev: The System detects the 'Luck' overflow and schedules a fix.
bridge.to_next: Arlo and Jax must race through a high-level territory to reach the 'Source Code' altar.

chapters.title: Running for His Life (Literally)
chapters.goal: Arlo faces the Zone Sentinel—a boss designed to punish runners—and must use his 'Crit Hit & Run' style to survive long enough for the patch timer to expire.
chapters.stakes_shift: From being fixed/deleted to becoming a 'Legacy Bug'—an unpatchable anomaly.

bridge.from_prev: The Sentinel blocks the path to the Altar.
bridge.to_next: The Altar is activated as the world fades to white for the 'update'.

chapters.title: The Legacy of the Glitch
chapters.goal: Arlo wakes up post-patch to find he has been granted the unique Title 'The Unfixable One', making him the only player capable of damaging 'Invulnerable' admin-level mobs.
chapters.stakes_shift: From a lucky coward to the most valuable (and hunted) asset in the game.

bridge.from_prev: The server comes back online with Arlo's stats intact.
bridge.to_next: The major guilds realize Arlo is the only one who can clear the new 'Endgame' content released in the patch.
